newsitem.title: LATVIA: BLUE CHIPS STABLE IN HIGHER TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BLUE CHIPS STABLE IN HIGHER TRADE.

text.p: Latvian blue chips were stable in higher trade on Thursday and dealers said they anticipated no significant price movements until June H1 company results are released.
Overall market volume was 77,000 lats compared to 46,000 lats at the previous session and the bourse index inched up to 384.92 from 384.32. The Rietumu index added 0.06 percent to 152.4.
Four of the five official list stocks held steady with only Unibanka gaining. It added two santimes to 3.37 lats in trade of 33,700 lats.
"No big price changes are expected on the market until some of the company results come out," said Girts Ozols, a dealer with Hansabank-Latvija.
On the secondary list, pharmaceutical maker Olainfarm rose to 2.57 lats from 2.55 lats.
The company reported on Thursday that its after-tax profit for the first quarter of its fiscal year, April-June, was expected to be around 330,000 lats.
The company had reported a loss of 1.62 million lats for the previous quarter and dealers said that the market might not respond immediately to the result.
"They say they 'expect' a profit of 330,000 lats, but the market wants the final figure," said one dealer.
Daugavpils Chain, which the bourse said on Thursday would move to the official list on July 14, shed two santimes to 1.08 lats in light trade of 1,500 lats.
Dealers said its move to the official list would not have an immediate impact on its price but probably would in the long-term.
